subject: Expanding Silverline: onboarding additional squads, API keys & cadence
body:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Lawrence <kate@silverline.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expanding Silverline: onboarding additional squads, API keys & cadence

Hi Kate —

Following our renewal call, Silverline mentioned adding 4 more squads (Search, Billing, Integrations, Research) to the existing tenant. Before we lock a rollout date, I want to confirm:

- Which squads should be staged in Phase 1 vs Phase 2?
- Desired start date for sandbox/key issuance for Phase 1?
- Any new throughput/latency SLAs or commit changes we should account for?

I've attached a one-page mutual action plan template and a provisioning CSV we generally use for app-to-key mappings. If you can fill the CSV for the Phase 1 squads, we can generate keys and schedule a credentials handoff.

Proposed next steps (quick):
1) You confirm squads + desired start dates (reply)
2) Silverline completes provisioning CSV (drive link)
3) We schedule a 45-min staging run and key handoff (within 5 business days of CSV)

If helpful, I can coordinate billing/term tweaks with our contracts team — Laura (cc) handles that.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake\Account Executive\Redwood Inference

---

From: Kate Lawrence <kate@silverline.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@silverline.io>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expanding Silverline: onboarding additional squads, API keys & cadence

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the note. Quick answers:
- Phase 1: Search + Integrations (we want those live early to support the Q3 launch).
- Phase 2 (targeting Q4): Billing + Research.
- Start date: we can start sandbox keys for Phase 1 the week of July 5th. Production keys to follow after a successful staging run; estimate July 19th for prod activation.

Throughput: Search will need higher per-minute throughput during peak (we estimate a sustained 3x of current baseline). Can Ben share a capacity plan?

I'll have Samir fill the provisioning CSV and put it in the shared Drive folder by EOD Friday.

Regards,
Kate Lawrence\Head of Platform\Silverline

Attachment: Silverline-MAP-v2.xlsx (1 sheet)

---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Lawrence <kate@silverline.io>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expanding Silverline: onboarding additional squads, API keys & cadence

Kate —

Thanks for the details. Quick capacity notes:
- Baseline tokens/min for current tenant: ~45k.
- Estimated Phase 1 (Search + Integrations): additional 90k tokens/min during peak windows.
- If Search sustains 3x current baseline during peak, we recommend a temporary burst pool and a small committed uplift to the Dedicated capacity during Q3.

Suggested technical rollout:
1) Sandbox keys (week of Jul 5) — no capacity changes needed; use existing sandbox pool.
2) Canaried prod activation (Jul 19) — split traffic to canary variant pinned to Search app, 10% traffic for 24 hours.
3) If canary metrics look good (latency, error rate), expand to 100% and enable burst pool.

I'll prepare a short capacity addendum that Laura can route for approval.

Best,
Ben Carter\Solutions Engineering\Redwood Inference

---

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Lawrence <kate@silverline.io>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expanding Silverline: onboarding additional squads, API keys & cadence

Thanks Ben — this aligns with what we discussed on the renewal call. Laura, rough ask: can we offer Silverline a 10% committed uplift for the Q3 window (Jul–Sep) at the renewal rate they signed, with a one-time credit if we need to fast-track additional GPUs for sustained peaks? I think that will give Search the headroom and keep costs predictable.

Laura — do you need anything else from my side to prepare the addendum? I attached the provisioning template again (redwood-provisioning-template.csv) — Kate/Samir, if you could return that with the app->owner->env mapping, we will generate keys and schedule the staging run.

Jordan

Attachment: redwood-provisioning-template.csv

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Kate Lawrence <kate@silverline.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expanding Silverline: onboarding additional squads, API keys & cadence

Hi all —

I can draft the Q3 committed uplift addendum. Quick confirmations I need from Silverline before sending:
- Final Phase 1 apps (you stated Search + Integrations; confirm owners and environments in the CSV)
- Whether the 10% uplift is billed monthly or as a one-time seasonal reserve credit (we can do either; monthly is simpler for accounting).

If Silverline opts for a one-time reserve credit, we can apply it against the July invoice once the addendum is signed. We will circulate a DocuSign link for signature and include a 30-day rollback clause in case traffic stays below forecast.

Kate/Samir — can you confirm the billing preference and upload the completed CSV by Wednesday 2027-06-30? Once I have those, I’ll send the addendum for e-signature and loop in Finance to reserve the capacity.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett\Senior Manager, Revenue Operations\Redwood Inference
